Set the format of the audio that is embedded in the video. Not all codec and audio codec combinations are supported and certain combinations require a certain file extension and container format. See the table in the docs to see possible combinations.

## CLI flag

Use `--audio-codec` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--audio-codec <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--audio-codec <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--audio-codec <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--audio-codec <value>` |
